I gotta give my compliments to AA for being great sports and being able to play the war on such shot notice. -[fs]Krazy" === DM3 === FS: 194 - AA: 45
[[Image:Fs aa dm3.gif]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/a/ab/Little_horn_fs_vs_aa_dm3_villains.qwz Little Horn (FS)]

"The first half was map Dm3, well [fs] had some damn unlucky spawns there, so AA managed to get all the powerups. But when the 30 sec. from each powerup went off , also their "control" went and [fs] was able to take control very fast after that. Also we found out that it aint good playing with so many different teams as [fs] does, because the team playing wasnt realy well played in on eachother. So the control was lost several times, this also because of the great powerup timing from clan AA. -[fs]Krazy" === E1M2 === FS: 285 - AA: 95
[[Image:Fs aa e1m2.gif]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/8/86/Little_horn_fs_vs_aa_e1m2_villains.qwz Little Horn (FS)]

"The second half was [fs] map (E1m2). Again we didnt manage to get full control over the level to do some respawn fragging. AA seemed to be able to get many Rl's and do some major damage from time to time. The quad timing from [fs] went better in e1m2 and gave us a great advantage which made it able for us to make an "easy" win on AA in this level. -[fs]Krazy" == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** FS: 479 ** AA: 140 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
